guidance.promptSnippet: Ask the user up to 4 structured questions (2-4 options each) via ask_user_question when a decision cannot be inferred. Hard limits: header ≤16 chars, option label ≤60 chars.
promptGuidelines: Use ask_user_question instead of guessing when requirements are ambiguous; batch every open question into one call (1-4 questions) rather than chaining calls.

ask_user_question option labels NAME a choice, they do not explain it: 1-5 words, target ≤40 characters. The schema rejects labels over 60 characters and the ' (Recommended)' suffix costs 14 of them, so never write a label as a clause or sentence. Move mechanisms, conditions, and trade-offs into `description`. Example: label 'Forbid granularity change', not 'Exact match + forbid changing granularity once invoices exist'.
ask_user_question `header` is required: a 1-2 word chip of at most 16 characters (e.g. 'Auth method'). `question` is a full sentence ending in '?'.

ask_user_question options: 2-4 per question, each with `label` + `description`. Never author 'Other', 'Type something.', or 'Next' as labels — the UI appends its own free-text row. Put the recommended option first with the label suffix '(Recommended)'. Use multiSelect: true for non-exclusive choices; `preview` (markdown mockups/code/config) only on single-select questions.
